messages:
nina: Heads-up: I'm landing a small docs PR that unifies metering examples across SDKs and adds a short migration note for tier label changes. Need a quick review on the examples and one dashboard link.

ade: Drop the examples here pls. I want to confirm the header names match the server side.

nina: Pasting two minimal examples. JS (fetch):

nina: ```js
// set-tier.js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
    'X-Redwood-Tier': 'team-standard',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-13b', input:'What's new?'})
});
console.log(await res.json());
```

nina: And a compact HTTP example for the migration guide: 

nina: ```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
X-Redwood-Tier: team-standard
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"What's new?"}
```

stef: Looks good. Two asks: add a tiny example of the usage export payload (so CSMs can wire dashboards) and mention the field rename from "tier_label" to "usage_tier".

nina: Adding analytics snippet: 

nina: ```json
{"export":[{"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"team-standard","value":8123},{"meter":"requests","usage_tier":"team-standard","value":12}]}
```

ade: Also note: during migration some accounts will see a transient key "graceAllowance" under quotas for legacy burst credits. We should recommend running the migration tool; include the CLI dry-run example.

nina: I'll add this bullet and the CLI example: `redwood migrate-quotas --org $ORG_ID --dry-run`. Also including the console panel link template: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage_panel_v4?acct={{acct_id}}. Callout: requires console:usage-read role.

stef: Editorial: prefer the phrase "legacy grants" instead of old slang. And add a short troubleshooting note: if customers still see "tier_label" in their export, they probably have an older billing schema; advise contacting finance with the export sample.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5033 — reviewers: @ade @stef

nina: Thanks — I'll update the PR with the panel link and analytics snippet and ping when CI passes. :rocket:
